name: OpenStreetMap Overpass Drainage
notes: Surface waterways, rivers, canals, streams, drains and ditches. Minor drains depend on OSM mapping completeness.

name: Known Flood Hotspots
provider: Compiled project asset from public reports and local flood references
refresh_method: manual GeoJSON update or geocode_hotspots.py when hotspots_seed.csv is available
coverage: Known Nagpur waterlogging and flood-affected locations
license: Project dataset with per-feature source notes
notes: Coordinates are estimated point references, not flood extent polygons.

name: VNIT Frequency Ratio Flood Susceptibility Model
refresh_method: static peer-reviewed model tables in nagpur_flood_data.json
notes: Frequency Ratio tables power the risk model and topography explorer.

name: IMD Weather and Rainfall APIs
refresh_method: server-side API integration after IMD API key/JWT is available
coverage: Official weather, nowcast, AWS/ARG and rainfall products
notes: Endpoints were verified but return 401 without credentials. Do not show as live data until keys are configured.

name: NATMO Nagpur Planning Map
provider: National Atlas and Thematic Mapping Organisation
refresh_method: manual GIS download or WFS integration after service validation
notes: Useful candidate for administrative or thematic context; not yet ingested into the app.
